title: Verify Technician can enter mileage and engine hours on a new work order line
preconds:
Log in to ShopView as a user assigned the Technician role. (mileage/engine hours are gated by Work Order Lines: Create and Edit per spec v33, which Technician has; Tech View makes EXISTING lines read-only, so test on a NEW line).
At least one work order exists.
steps:
1. Open a work order and add a NEW line.
2. Enter a Mileage value on the new line and save.
3. Enter an Engine Hours value and save.
4. Open an EXISTING (previously saved/approved) line and try the same edits.
expected:
Step 1: A new line is created.
Step 2: Mileage saves successfully on the new line.
Step 3: Engine Hours saves successfully on the new line.
Step 4: On the existing line the fields are read-only (Tech View caveat) - record the actual behavior for confirmation.
